fixture_contract.unsigned_protected_request: Return the payment-required response before invoking the protected handler, regardless of HTTP method.
fixture_contract.free_response: Invoke the handler without requiring payment.
fixture_contract.verified_payment: Invoke the protected handler; settlement may subsequently fail while its response is buffered.
fixture_contract.settlement_failure: May return HTTP 402 after handler execution; never grants replay authority.

limits: Local fixtures model these branches. They do not qualify arbitrary provider middleware, POST idempotency, or live settlement.
